marker_track — DRIVE tacslip op

• Data kinds: image2d × image2d × scalar × scalar × scalar → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.marker_track(m_ref, m_cur, dark: 'float', pitch_px: 'float', r_px: 'float', piv: 'bool' = False) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import tacslip; tacslip.marker_track(m_ref, m_cur, dark: 'float', pitch_px: 'float', r_px: 'float', piv: 'bool' = False) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("marker_track"))

Usage

Displacement vector field from reference and loaded marker images (marker_image): detection (marker_detect, 2 images) → correspondence by continuity (marker_match_grow) → u = p1 − p0 [px]. Returns p0, p1, u (each (M, 2)), matched, n0, n1. With piv=True, the field of pivops.piv_cross_correlate (2nd implementation, search ±0.12 window) is attached as piv_flow, piv_info, piv_at (a function that samples it at a point list). Raises ValueError: the 2 images differ in shape.
